walkingOrder.title: Walking order
walkingOrder.description: How measurers walk the field. Phones receive it when their next session starts.

byRow.label: By row
byRow.description: Walks the layout row by row. Rows measured late in the day differ in light and heat from rows measured early.

serpentine.label: Serpentine
serpentine.description: Walks row by row and turns back at each row end. It saves walking but keeps the time-of-day risk of by row.

random.label: Random over the whole field
random.description: Shuffles every plot in the field, blocks or not. It does not balance treatments along the walk, so a run of the day can hold more of one treatment.

randomByBlock.label: Random by block
randomByBlock.description: Shuffles the plots within each block. Time of day no longer follows the layout inside a block.

treatmentBalanced.label: Treatment-balanced
treatmentBalanced.description: Spreads every treatment evenly across the walk, so no treatment is measured mostly early or mostly late.

walkingOrder.balance: Any {{window}} consecutive plots in the walk hold each treatment in proportion to its plots in the field, give or take one.
walkingOrder.unbalanced: Steps {{first}} to {{last}} hold a treatment more or less often than the balance allows.
walkingOrder.orderCodeHint: The same code always rebuilds this order. A new code changes the order for sessions that start after you save, never walks already recorded.

divide.title: Divide the field
divide.description: Give each measurer a share of the walking order. Each share becomes the assignment their phone receives at its next session start.

equalShares.label: Equal shares along the walk
equalShares.protects: Every measurer gets the same number of plots, each share balanced across treatments.
equalShares.costs: Each measurer walks across every block.

rowBands.label: Row bands
rowBands.protects: Each block stays with one measurer, so differences between measurers fall inside the block differences the analysis already separates.
rowBands.costs: Shares are unequal when blocks do not divide evenly between measurers.

divide.paintHint: Pick a measurer, then click or drag over plots. With the keyboard, move with the arrow keys and press Space to paint.
divide.missingWarning: A share missing a treatment ties this measurer to the treatments it holds.
divide.outsideWarning: This share holds a treatment more or less often than the tolerance allows.
divide.noOverlap: No plot is in two shares.
divide.inviteDescription: A measurer has to be a member of this experiment before they can get a share. Invite one, and they appear here once they accept.
divide.replaceDescription: A new order code builds a new walking order, and the shares are cut from it again. The plots you painted by hand go back to the split.

fieldDays.noSessionDescription: Nobody ended a session on the day you chose. Pick another day, or wait for measurers to finish.

live.title: Live progress
live.quiet: Uploaded {{time}}. The phone may be out of signal, and its readings arrive when it reconnects.
live.noUploadHint: Nothing has arrived from this phone today.

overview.title: Overview of the day
overview.measuredTwiceLine: {{plots}} hold readings nobody asked to repeat. A person decides which reading stands.
overview.gridDescription: {{measured}} of {{total}} plots measured on this day

measuredTwice.title: Measured twice
measuredTwice.description: Plots more than one reading landed on without a repeat. Keep the reading that stands, and the others stay in the data, left out of it.
measuredTwice.noneOpen: Every plot measured twice is resolved.
measuredTwice.none: No plot has been measured twice.
measuredTwice.explanation: {{names}} both measured {{plot}}, and neither asked for a repeat.
measuredTwice.resolved: {{plot}}: kept {{kept}}'s reading. The other stays in the data, left out of it.
